title: Parthenolide targets NF-kappaB (P50) to inhibit HIF-1alpha-mediated metabolic reprogramming of HCC.
authors: Liu, Xiaorong; Gao, Zhaofeng; Wang, Xiaoguang; Shen, Yiyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Parthenolide靶向NF-kappaB P50抑制HCC代谢重编程，虽含小分子-蛋白对接，但核心是药物靶点与肿瘤代谢，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法上仅简单对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: We focus on investigating the role of Parthenolide (Par), a small sesquiterpenoid molecule, in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and its effective target.Highly-metastatic HCC cells, MHCC97-H, were divided into the DMSO and the Par groups, of which the Par group was intervened at 5 and 10 mg/L doses. Cell viability was assessed by CCK-8 assay. Transwell chamber assay was performed to examine the metastatic and invasive abilities, while plate clone formation assay was conducted to detect the clone formation ability. For analysis of glucose uptake, glycolytic ability and lactate level, the glycolysis assay was employed. Brdu staining was performed to evaluate the cell proliferative potential. The P50 and HIF-1alpha levels were measured by immunofluorescence, while the expressions of p-P50 and HIF-1alpha were determined by Western-Blot. Small molecule-protein docking and Pull-down experiments were conducted to validate the Par-P50 binding model. After establishing the tumor-bearing mouse model, Par was administered by gavage to measure the tissue levels of P50 and HIF-1alpha, followed by plotting of tumor growth curves.Par could inhibit the metastatic, invasive and clone formation abilities of MHCC97-H cells, reduce the cell proliferative potential, and suppress the glycolysis, as manifested by down-regulated level of lactate and reduced oxygen consumption. Meanwhile, Par inhibited the HIF-1alpha expression. We found that after silencing P50, the HIF-1alpha was down-regulated, the glycolytic ability decreased drastically, and the cellular metastatic and invasive abilities were suppressed. After P50 knockout, the effect of Par intervention on the MHCC97-H cells was reduced. In HCC-bearing mice, Par also exhibited an excellent anti-tumor effect, decreasing the tissue levels of P50 and HIF-1alpha.This study discovers that Par can inhibit the HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolysis of HCC cells by targeting P50, thereby exerting an anti-tumor effect. P50 is a major effective target of Par.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨小白菊内酯（Parthenolide, Par）——一种小分子倍半萜内酯化合物，在肝细胞癌（hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC）中的作用及其有效靶点。将高转移性HCC细胞MHCC97-H分为DMSO组和Par组，其中Par组分别以5和10 mg/L剂量进行干预。通过CCK-8实验评估细胞活力；采用Transwell小室实验检测细胞迁移和侵袭能力，同时进行平板克隆形成实验以检测克隆形成能力。为分析葡萄糖摄取、糖酵解能力和乳酸水平，采用糖酵解实验；通过Brdu染色评估细胞增殖潜力。利用免疫荧光法检测P50和HIF-1α水平，并通过Western-Blot测定p-P50和HIF-1α的表达。进行小分子-蛋白质对接和Pull-down实验以验证Par-P50结合模型。建立荷瘤小鼠模型后，通过灌胃给予Par，测量组织中P50和HIF-1α水平，并绘制肿瘤生长曲线。Par能够抑制MHCC97-H细胞的迁移、侵袭和克隆形成能力，降低细胞增殖潜力，并抑制糖酵解，表现为乳酸水平下调和耗氧量减少。同时，Par抑制HIF-1α表达。我们发现，沉默P50后，HIF-1α下调，糖酵解能力显著降低，细胞迁移和侵袭能力受到抑制。P50敲除后，Par干预对MHCC97-H细胞的作用减弱。在HCC荷瘤小鼠中，Par也表现出优异的抗肿瘤效果，降低了组织中P50和HIF-1α水平。本研究揭示，Par通过靶向P50抑制HIF-1α介导的HCC细胞糖酵解，从而发挥抗肿瘤作用。P50是Par的主要有效靶点。
